title: Color Chain
tagline: Match, shed, and keep the chain going.
taglineZh: 接颜色，接数字，先出完手牌。

lines.en: Color Chain. A shedding game for the family table.
lines.zh: 颜色接龙。给全家人的出牌游戏。

lines.en: Match the colour or the number, and keep the chain moving.
lines.zh: 接颜色、接数字，让牌链一直走下去。

lines.en: Skip, reverse, draw two — or call a colour with a wild.
lines.zh: 跳过、反转、罚两张——万能牌还能改颜色。

lines.en: Empty your hand first. Leave the fewest points when the match hits two hundred.
lines.zh: 先出完手牌；总分到 200 时，分最低的人赢。

lines.en: Four AI levels, or two to six players on one screen and over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 四档 AI；二到六人同屏，或连同一 Wi-Fi。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record. Offline, no account, no ads.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。离线、无账号、无广告。

lines.en: Color Chain. Keep the chain going.
lines.zh: 颜色接龙。让牌链接下去。
